title: Correct and version the book evidence registry
acceptance_criteria: The repo/book-evidence-registry-v1 snapshot and root v1 registry files remain unchanged and are cited by the correction ledger
Exactly one versioned registry is declared active for book numeric prose and the evidence tool defaults to that version without silent fallback
Atomic claims use structured support keys that resolve to committed report or result artifacts and keep run-level status separate from selected support-cell status

Winner eligibility, same-run negative-control scope, multi-run anchors, trial dimensions, extant producing tags and commits are validated; claim-01 is explicitly legacy_provenance_incomplete rather than guessed
The six conclusion confounds, a methodology coverage matrix with review state, physical placement as a common gap, and native-datastore plus real-network/balanced-endpoint gap records are included

A synthesis handoff maps the fixed six-family taxonomy to answerability-first, the multidimensional design vector, the derive-index-materialize-copy ladder, contention/arbitration, query boundaries, evidence-confidence cards and the failure-mode catalogue, with direct evidence, analogy and gap labels
No evidence strength is upgraded and no numeric cross-study ranking is introduced
No report, analysis, discussion, result, manifest, existing tag, existing review task or existing book-synthesis task is edited or superseded
expected_artifacts: updated tools/evidence validator and regression fixtures
updated book/evidence/README.md declaring the sole active registry
validation: Run tools/evidence Go tests in Podman and validate the active registry from a clean committed tree
Reproduce the v1 diagnostic baseline of 11 of 12 numeric claims affected and 36 of 43 declared names unresolved, then prove all active v2 support keys resolve semantically

Negative fixtures reject unresolved support keys, scope-conflated failed-cell counts, ineligible winners, missing control scope, ambiguous trial dimensions, missing extant tags and unsupported multi-run claims
Verify every active path, digest, environment, topology, tag, commit, report and signed analysis link and audit the queue
Diff the v1 registry files against repo/book-evidence-registry-v1 and prove they are byte-for-byte unchanged
Render or inspect generated book-input tables sufficiently to catch swapped identities, truncated limits and duplicate active sources
review_policy: Independent HIGH review required; review the Decision Log first, rerun the mechanical baseline and semantic resolver checks, and reject any change to v1, dual active claim source, strength upgrade or unlabelled transfer
